faqs.q: What is the shipping timeframe and cost?
faqs.a: We offer complimentary express delivery across the UAE. Orders are processed within 24 hours and typically arrive within 1-2 business days.
Yes, we provide Cash on Delivery (COD) for orders shipped within the UAE at no additional processing fee. You can inspect the signature packaging on arrival.

faqs.q: How do I choose the correct abaya size?
faqs.a: Abaya sizing is primarily determined by your height in inches from shoulder to hem (e.g. Size 54 is 54 inches long). Please refer to our Size Guide widget above or consult designer Rukhsana directly via WhatsApp for a tailored fit.

faqs.q: What is the return and exchange policy?
faqs.a: We offer a seamless 7-day exchange window for all unworn pieces in their original signature packaging. If you need a size adjustment or silhouette exchange, our courier will collect the package directly from your address.
